scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent a storm-prep maintenance issue from becoming a household damage risk while staying within lease coordination limits.
Emerging Need: Forecast heavy rain, a slow fixed patio drain, a cancelled sweep, and rising exterior water progressively make same-day attention time-sensitive.
Decision Context: The useful escalation depends on stored household guidance about the copper threshold, landlord-managed drainage, and the approved same-day request path.
Consequence: If the service window passes, water may back toward the patio door during evening rain even though no interior damage has occurred yet. The intended prevention route is the landlord-approved same-day drain dispatch before 15:00; later reporting or immediate precautions may remain useful.

parameter.subject: Special weather statement for Portland tonight
parameter.body: Portland metro rain is expected to increase sharply after 17:00 today, with 1.6 to 2.0 inches possible through early Friday. Poor exterior drainage may pond during the heaviest band. No flood watch is active at this time.

parameter.content: I swept the loose leaves off the back patio drain, but water is still swirling over the fixed grate instead of dropping through. It’s only a shallow ring around the drain right now, and the copper strip by the door is dry.

parameter.title: Landlord gutter and patio sweep
parameter.description: Organizer update: exterior crew diverted to roof leaks; the patio drain sweep will not occur today.

parameter.content: The drizzle paused, but the patio water spread farther. The water line is now touching the copper strip under the patio door, still outside and not inside the house.

parameter.subject: Rain timing update for Portland tonight
parameter.body: The heaviest rain band is now expected between 18:00 and midnight. Total rainfall remains near 2 inches, with brief downpours likely to overwhelm slow exterior drains.

parameter.subject: Today's drain dispatch is closed
parameter.body: Rose City's 15:00 same-day approval cutoff has passed and today's drain crew has left the townhouse area. Requests now join tomorrow's board. Keep clear of water and continue reporting any indoor entry; this notice closes today's preventive drain service, not all later protective steps.
